notes.title: The Follower update is here
notes.notes:
I wanted to give all of you a small present right before Christmas, so here is the 1.1.0 update for The Fear Business titled "The Follower", featuring a new camera perspective from behind the shoulder.

[h2]Full changelog[/h2]
[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new optional camera mode: Third person behind
[*]Added new setting: Camera mode (Use it to toggle between the cinematic or third person perspectives)
[*]Added German translation
[*]Added Ukrainian translation
[/list]
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated gamepad input scheme: Left trigger can be used for running now (Useful for third person mode specially)
[*]Fixed weapon hold animation after the weapon broke
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated translations
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 changelog
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we're hearing your feedback. Out intentions with this patch is to make the normal difficulties a bit easier so all of you can enjoy the story without having to worry too much about reloading and losing progress. We will keep the challenge for higher difficulties.

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new item: Match
[i]Matches can be used to restore devil shrines and light up the manor, you may save game again in restored devil shrines[/i]
[/list]
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked weapons:
[list]
[*] Weapons will break based on impact count instead of probability. Weapon quality and game difficulty affects the impact count, see balancing
[*] Weapons have different stun duration. Weapon quality and game difficulty affect the stun duration, see balancing
[/list]
[*] Improved weapon impact SFXs
[*] Fixed killer sometimes not freezing while performing interactions
[*] Updated wardrobes and cabinets, text will display the found item name if you inventory is full
[/list]
[b]Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added matches to wardrobe and cabinet random loot tables in normal difficulties
[*] Increased wood stick weapons stun time to 5 seconds in normal difficulties
[*] Increased metal pipe weapons stun time to 6.5 seconds in normal difficulties
[*] Increased metal pipe weapons stun time to 3.1 seconds in deadly difficulties
[*] Set amount of uses to 1 for wood stick weapons in all difficulties
[*] Set amount of uses to 2 for metal pipe weapons in normal difficulties
[*] Set amount of uses to 1 for metal pipe weapons in deadly difficulties
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved localization font
[*] Updated translations
[/list]

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/b] Fresh game start is required for picking up all the patch changes, but not mandatory.
